reply.text:
Bigger bench comes down to a few levers: benching with enough frequency to groove the pattern (2x a week beats 1x for most people), building a base of volume in the 6-10 rep range, and keeping a heavier top set or two to stay strong at low reps. Pair that with real tricep and upper back work, since both are what stalls a bench before the chest does.

Want me to build you a block around that - more bench frequency and the accessory work to back it up?
